hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; files=$( { git diff --name-only -- '*.swift'; git diff --name-only --cached -- '*.swift'; } 2>/dev/null | sort -u); [ -z "$files" ] && exit 0; echo '[verify] Swift files changed — syntax-checking:'; echo "$files"; out=$(echo "$files" | xargs -I{} xcrun swift -frontend -parse "{}" 2>&1); echo "$out" | grep -E 'error:|warning:' | head -20; echo "$out" | grep -q 'error:' && exit 1 || exit 0
